Shrunk Ghost S1 ITX Case

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2700872-shrunk-ghost-s1-itx-case#profileId-2994055

I designed a compact ITX case inspired by the iconic Ghost S1. Everything is rigid, secure, and it gives you that confidence that you could move it around, transport it, and not worry about anything breaking. When it comes to compatibility, it fits everything you’d expect from a case in the 6-liter class or smaller, so you’re not giving anything up despite the compact size.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 3 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 3
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PETG (#161616)
